import json,sys,http.client,pathlib,subprocess
sha="f2d273fe1cd6dbddfb6b490c320291af650e106b"
def check(k,ok):
 print(k+"="+("PASS" if ok else "FAIL"),flush=True)
 if not ok:raise RuntimeError(k)
token=(pathlib.Path.home()/".config"/"tgtumbler"/"tumblr-operation-app"/"tumblr-app-access-token").read_text().strip()
def send(path,payload=None,auth=True):
 c=http.client.HTTPConnection("127.0.0.1",8081,timeout=8)
 headers={"Content-Type":"application/json"}
 if auth:headers["Authorization"]="Bearer "+token
 try:
  c.request("POST" if payload is not None else "GET",path,body=json.dumps(payload).encode() if payload is not None else None,headers=headers)
  response=c.getresponse()
  return response.status,json.loads(response.read(300000))
 finally:c.close()
try:
 code,health=send("/healthz")
 check("LIVE_SHA",code==200 and health.get("commit")==sha)
 goals=["巡回","投稿","キャンペーン","紹介","集計","メディア"]
 code,data=send("/assistant",{"message":"","goals":goals})
 check("ALL_SIX_GOALS",code==200 and data.get("state")=="guidance" and data.get("plan",{}).get("goals")==goals)
 check("UNCONNECTED_GOALS_EXPLICIT",data.get("plan",{}).get("not_connected_goals")==["キャンペーン","紹介"])
 check("NO_AUTO_EXECUTION",data.get("executed") is False)
 code,data=send("/assistant",{"selected_action":"analytics.get_summary","selected_target":"week"})
 check("REAL_ANALYTICS",code==200 and data.get("state")=="completed" and data.get("executed") is True)
 check("REAL_ANALYTICS_RECORDS",data.get("view",{}).get("rows",[{}])[0].get("label")=="確認済み候補数")
 code,data=send("/assistant",{"selected_action":"tumblr.publish_draft","selected_target":"myblog"})
 check("PUBLISH_CONFIRM_REQUIRED",code==200 and data.get("state")=="confirmation_required" and data.get("executed") is False)
 code,data=send("/assistant",{"selected_action":"tumblr.delete_blog","selected_target":"myblog"})
 check("UNREGISTERED_ACTION_REJECTED",code==200 and data.get("state")=="invalid_tool" and data.get("executed") is False)
 code,_=send("/assistant",{"goals":goals},auth=False)
 check("UNAUTHORIZED_REJECTED",code==401)
 print("PROVIDER_API_CALLS=ZERO")
 print("ACCEPTANCE=PASS")
except Exception as exc:
 print("ACCEPTANCE=FAIL:"+type(exc).__name__,flush=True)
 sys.exit(42)
